header: CN 109678767 A    权　利　要　求　书    1/1 页

paragraphs.zh: 1.一种除草剂环磺酮的合成工艺，包括有以下步骤：
paragraphs.en: 1. A process for the synthesis of the herbicide tembotrione, comprising the following steps:
paragraphs.notes: PROVENANCE FOR THIS WHOLE PAGE: the zh fields were EXTRACTED from the PDF's own embedded text layer, not transcribed from pixels. CN109678767A is born digital and all 37 printed body lines on this page carry real text, so the layer is the publication's own encoding and is authoritative for characters; it is reproduced character for character, full-width punctuation included, with nothing normalised and nothing corrected. Only layout (paragraph boundaries, header, footer, and the absence of any drawing) was read off the rendered image. A later reader can therefore treat every zh character on this page as extracted rather than model-read. MARKERS: this is the claims page and it carries NO [00NN] paragraph markers of any kind. The marker field below carries the printed claim number, plus the sub-part inside claim 1, and is a convention of this file rather than anything printed on the page. LINE WRAPS: CNIPA wraps mid-name with no hyphen and no space; multi-line paragraphs here were joined with NO separator inserted, which is exactly what the text layer contains (verified: no line on this page holds a space character at all). PARAGRAPH SPLIT: the 16 paragraphs below were cut at the 16 first-line indents measured on the image (indented lines start at x=241-243 px, continuation lines at x=182-190 px). Claim 1 occupies SEVEN printed paragraphs (this one plus the next six) and must be reassembled from them. NAME: 环磺酮 is a Chinese common name and this page gives NO English gloss for it. It is rendered 'tembotrione' on the strength of '除草剂环磺酮(Tembotrione)' printed on p03 of the same publication, not on anything visible on this page.

paragraphs.zh: 1)2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯的合成
paragraphs.notes: Step number printed with a half-width ')' (U+0029). Every claim number and step number on this page uses half-width ASCII punctuation ('.' U+002E, ')' U+0029, ':' U+003A); there is no full-width variant of any of them anywhere on the page, so unlike some CNIPA publications this page is internally consistent and downstream passes may rely on its punctuation widths.

paragraphs.zh: 将2-氯-3-甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯、溶剂、催化剂、氢溴酸加入反应瓶，在80℃以下滴加双氧水，滴加完毕后继续反应，LC跟踪至反应完全，反应完全后分层，有机层水洗，浓缩，加溶剂进行重结晶，过滤得2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯；
paragraphs.en: Methyl 2-chloro-3-methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate, solvent, catalyst and hydrobromic acid are charged into a reaction flask; hydrogen peroxide is added dropwise at or below 80 C; after the addition is complete the reaction is continued, followed by LC until the reaction is complete; after completion the layers are separated, the organic layer is washed with water and concentrated, solvent is added for recrystallisation, and filtration gives methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate;
paragraphs.notes: 双氧水 is aqueous hydrogen peroxide (literally 'double-oxygen water'). 氢溴酸 is hydrobromic acid. LC is used as the reaction monitor. '在80℃以下' means 'at or below 80 C'; ℃ is the single character U+2103, not a degree sign followed by a Latin C. Both 溶剂 (solvent) and 催化剂 (catalyst) are unnamed placeholders here and are defined by claims 3 and 4. NOTHING has been inferred about the brominating species: the paragraph never names Br2 or any bromine reagent even though the product is the bromomethyl compound - see discrepancies.

paragraphs.zh: 2)2-氯-3-(2,2,2-三氟乙氧基)甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸的合成
paragraphs.notes: The name is reproduced with the printed bracketing: '(2,2,2-三氟乙氧基)甲基' attached at C3 with no outer bracket, where strict IUPAC would write 3-[(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl]. The English keeps the printed form. Both parentheses around the trifluoroethoxy group are HALF-WIDTH and the locant commas inside are half-width; this is symmetric and identical at all four occurrences on the page.

paragraphs.zh: 将2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯、碱1、催化剂、溶剂、2,2,2-三氟乙醇加入反应瓶，在80℃以下进行反应，LC跟踪至反应完全，反应完毕后过滤，有机层水洗，浓缩；往剩余物里加碱2、水，在80℃以下进行碱解，LC跟踪至反应完全，反应完全后滴加盐酸酸化，过滤，洗涤，烘干得2-氯-3-(2,2,2-三氟乙氧基)甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸；
paragraphs.en: Methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate, base 1, catalyst, solvent and 2,2,2-trifluoroethanol are charged into a reaction flask and reacted at or below 80 C, followed by LC until the reaction is complete; after the reaction is finished the mixture is filtered, the organic layer is washed with water and concentrated; base 2 and water are added to the residue and alkaline hydrolysis is carried out at or below 80 C, followed by LC until the reaction is complete; after completion hydrochloric acid is added dropwise to acidify, and filtration, washing and drying give 2-chloro-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid;
paragraphs.notes: The reagent is 2,2,2-三氟乙醇, the free ALCOHOL (2,2,2-trifluoroethanol), charged together with 碱1 (base 1) and a catalyst. It is NOT a preformed alkoxide; no 三氟乙醇钠 appears anywhere on this page. 碱解 is alkaline hydrolysis, i.e. saponification of the methyl ester by 碱2. 碱1 and 碱2 are numbered placeholders resolved by claim 6. One printed paragraph carries two stages: etherification, then saponification and acidification. No intermediate ester is isolated or named between them.
环磺酮 again, with no English gloss anywhere on this page - see the note on the claim 1 preamble for the basis of the English rendering.

paragraphs.zh: 将2-氯-3-(2,2,2-三氟乙氧基)甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸、催化剂、氯化亚砜、溶剂加入反应瓶，升温回流反应，反应完毕后脱尽溶剂；将1,3-环己二酮、溶剂加入反应瓶，在30℃以下滴加三乙胺，LC跟踪至反应完全；反应完全后，加入丙酮氰醇，LC跟踪至反应完全，反应完全后加入水进行水洗，分层，油层脱尽溶剂，加溶剂进行重结晶，过滤，烘干得米黄色固体环磺酮。
paragraphs.en: 2-Chloro-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid, catalyst, thionyl chloride and solvent are charged into a reaction flask, the temperature is raised and the mixture is reacted at reflux; after the reaction is finished the solvent is stripped off completely; 1,3-cyclohexanedione and solvent are charged into a reaction flask, triethylamine is added dropwise at or below 30 C, and the reaction is followed by LC until complete; after completion acetone cyanohydrin is added and the reaction is followed by LC until complete; after completion water is added and the mixture is washed with water and separated into layers, the solvent is stripped completely from the oil layer, solvent is added for recrystallisation, and filtration and drying give tembotrione as a rice-yellow (beige) solid.
paragraphs.notes: 丙酮氰醇 verified character for character: it reads ACETONE CYANOHYDRIN, and is NOT 氰基丙酮 (cyanoacetone). The diketone here DOES carry its locant: 1,3-环己二酮 (cyclohexane-1,3-dione), with a half-width comma in the locant. 氯化亚砜 is thionyl chloride. 米黄色 rendered literally as 'rice-yellow', i.e. beige or cream. The sequence implied is acid chloride formation, then enol ester formation with triethylamine, then the cyanide-catalysed rearrangement, but the paragraph names no intermediate at all between the acid and the final product and isolates no enol ester; nothing has been inserted. '将1,3-环己二酮、溶剂加入反应瓶' does not say whether this is the same flask or a second one - Chinese has no article - and the English keeps that ambiguity. No yield, no reaction time, no pressure and no reflux temperature figure is given anywhere in claim 1.

paragraphs.zh: 2.根据权利要求1所述的除草剂环磺酮的合成工艺，其特征在于，步骤1)中，2-氯-3-甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯、催化剂、氢溴酸、双氧水的摩尔比为1:0.01～0.1:1～2:1～2。
paragraphs.en: 2. The process for the synthesis of the herbicide tembotrione according to claim 1, characterised in that, in step 1), the molar ratio of methyl 2-chloro-3-methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate, catalyst, hydrobromic acid and hydrogen peroxide is 1:0.01-0.1:1-2:1-2.
paragraphs.notes: Four components, four ratio parts, checked against each other: methyl ester 1, catalyst 0.01-0.1, hydrobromic acid 1-2, hydrogen peroxide 1-2. The range mark is the full-width tilde U+FF5E, used for every numeric range on this page; the colons and decimal points inside the ratio are half-width ASCII. The ratio is rendered in English with plain hyphens for the ranges.

paragraphs.zh: 3.根据权利要求1或2所述的除草剂环磺酮的合成工艺，其特征在于，步骤1)中，所述催化剂为偶氮二异丁腈或间氯过氧苯甲酸；双氧水的滴加温度为45～80℃。
paragraphs.en: 3. The process for the synthesis of the herbicide tembotrione according to claim 1 or 2, characterised in that, in step 1), said catalyst is azobisisobutyronitrile or m-chloroperoxybenzoic acid; the dropwise addition temperature of the hydrogen peroxide is 45-80 C.
paragraphs.notes: 偶氮二异丁腈 is azobisisobutyronitrile (AIBN); 间氯过氧苯甲酸 is m-chloroperoxybenzoic acid (mCPBA). Both are printed as alternatives filling the same 催化剂 slot and are translated exactly as printed. They are chemically different kinds of reagent, which is flagged in discrepancies and NOT resolved here. The 45-80 C addition window narrows step 1)'s 'at or below 80 C'; the two are consistent, not contradictory.

paragraphs.zh: 4.根据权利要求1或2所述的除草剂环磺酮的合成工艺，其特征在于，步骤1)中，所述反应溶剂为二氯甲烷、1,2-二氯乙烷或氯仿；所述结晶溶剂为甲醇、乙醇、异丙醇或正丁醇。
paragraphs.en: 4. The process for the synthesis of the herbicide tembotrione according to claim 1 or 2, characterised in that, in step 1), said reaction solvent is dichloromethane, 1,2-dichloroethane or chloroform; said crystallisation solvent is methanol, ethanol, isopropanol or n-butanol.
paragraphs.notes: This claim resolves the bare word 溶剂, used twice in claim 1 step 1), into two distinct roles: a chlorinated reaction solvent and an alcoholic crystallisation solvent.

paragraphs.zh: 5.根据权利要求1所述的除草剂环磺酮的合成工艺，其特征在于，步骤2)中，2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯、碱1、催化剂、2,2,2-三氟乙醇、碱2的摩尔比为1:1～2:0.01～0.1:1～2:1～2。
paragraphs.en: 5. The process for the synthesis of the herbicide tembotrione according to claim 1, characterised in that, in step 2), the molar ratio of methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate, base 1, catalyst, 2,2,2-trifluoroethanol and base 2 is 1:1-2:0.01-0.1:1-2:1-2.
paragraphs.notes: Five components, five ratio parts, checked against each other: methyl ester 1, base 1 1-2, catalyst 0.01-0.1, 2,2,2-trifluoroethanol 1-2, base 2 1-2. The solvent is deliberately absent from the ratio. The ratio string wraps across a printed line break between '0.01' and '～0.1'; the two lines were joined with no separator, as the text layer has them.

paragraphs.zh: 6.根据权利要求1或5所述的除草剂环磺酮的合成工艺，其特征在于，步骤2)中，所述碱1为碳酸钾；所述催化剂为三乙烯二胺或2-甲基三乙烯二胺；所述碱2为氢氧化钠、氢氧化钾或氢氧化锂。
paragraphs.en: 6. The process for the synthesis of the herbicide tembotrione according to claim 1 or 5, characterised in that, in step 2), said base 1 is potassium carbonate; said catalyst is triethylenediamine or 2-methyltriethylenediamine; said base 2 is sodium hydroxide, potassium hydroxide or lithium hydroxide.
paragraphs.notes: 碳酸钾 is potassium carbonate. 三乙烯二胺 is the common Chinese name for DABCO (1,4-diazabicyclo[2.2.2]octane); it is rendered literally as 'triethylenediamine' as printed rather than substituted with DABCO. 2-甲基三乙烯二胺 rendered literally as 2-methyltriethylenediamine; the page gives no structure for it and none has been inferred. 碱2 resolves to an alkali metal hydroxide, consistent with the 碱解 saponification in claim 1 step 2).

paragraphs.zh: 7.根据权利要求1或5所述的除草剂环磺酮的合成工艺，其特征在于，步骤2)中所述溶剂为乙腈、DMF、丙酮或四氢呋喃；反应温度为0～80℃。
paragraphs.en: 7. The process for the synthesis of the herbicide tembotrione according to claim 1 or 5, characterised in that the solvent described in step 2) is acetonitrile, DMF, acetone or tetrahydrofuran; the reaction temperature is 0-80 C.
paragraphs.notes: TYPOGRAPHY: this is the only claim on the page that prints '步骤2)中所述溶剂' with NO comma after 中. Claims 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 8, 9 and 10 all print '中，'. Reproduced as printed and reflected in the English by dropping the corresponding pause. 乙腈 acetonitrile, 丙酮 acetone, 四氢呋喃 tetrahydrofuran. DMF appears here as a SOLVENT for step 2), whereas claim 10 makes DMF the CATALYST for step 3): two different roles in two different steps, which is not a contradiction. The 0-80 C window narrows step 2)'s 'at or below 80 C'.

paragraphs.zh: 8.根据权利要求1所述的除草剂环磺酮的合成工艺，其特征在于，步骤3)中，2-氯-3-(2,2,2-三氟乙氧基)甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸、催化剂、氯化亚砜、1,3-环己二酮、三乙胺、丙酮氰醇的摩尔比为1:0.01～0.1:1～2:1～2:2～3:0.01～0.1。
paragraphs.en: 8. The process for the synthesis of the herbicide tembotrione according to claim 1, characterised in that, in step 3), the molar ratio of 2-chloro-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid, catalyst, thionyl chloride, 1,3-cyclohexanedione, triethylamine and acetone cyanohydrin is 1:0.01-0.1:1-2:1-2:2-3:0.01-0.1.
paragraphs.notes: Six components, six ratio parts, checked against each other: acid 1, catalyst 0.01-0.1, thionyl chloride 1-2, 1,3-cyclohexanedione 1-2, triethylamine 2-3, acetone cyanohydrin 0.01-0.1. Triethylamine is the only component loaded above stoichiometric. Acetone cyanohydrin at 0.01-0.1 is explicitly a catalytic loading, which corroborates its catalytic role in claim 1 step 3), though the page never labels it a catalyst. The component name wraps across a printed line break in the middle of the locant string, between '2-氯-3-' and '(2,2,2-三氟乙氧基)'; joined with no separator.

paragraphs.zh: 9.根据权利要求1或8所述的除草剂环磺酮的合成工艺，其特征在于，步骤3)中，三乙胺的滴加温度为0～30℃。
paragraphs.en: 9. The process for the synthesis of the herbicide tembotrione according to claim 1 or 8, characterised in that, in step 3), the dropwise addition temperature of the triethylamine is 0-30 C.
paragraphs.notes: Narrows step 3)'s 'at or below 30 C' to 0-30 C. Consistent, not contradictory.

paragraphs.zh: 10.根据权利要求1或9所述的除草剂环磺酮的合成工艺，其特征在于，步骤3)中，催化剂为DMF；结晶溶剂为甲醇、乙醇、异丙醇或正丁醇。
paragraphs.en: 10. The process for the synthesis of the herbicide tembotrione according to claim 1 or 9, characterised in that, in step 3), the catalyst is DMF; the crystallisation solvent is methanol, ethanol, isopropanol or n-butanol.
paragraphs.notes: 催化剂为DMF resolves the unnamed 催化剂 of claim 1 step 3) as DMF, the conventional catalyst for acyl chloride formation with thionyl chloride, though the page does not say why. The crystallisation solvent list is character-identical to claim 4's list for step 1). DEPENDENCY CHAIN as printed across the whole page: 2 on 1; 3 and 4 on 1 or 2; 5 on 1; 6 and 7 on 1 or 5; 8 on 1; 9 on 1 or 8; 10 on 1 or 9. Claim 10 is the last mark of any kind in the body; the remaining lower quarter of the page is blank apart from the footer page number '2'.

discrepancies.what: There are NO drawings on this page, so every entry below is text-vs-text or image-vs-text-layer. Chemistry-plausibility flag: the step-1 catalyst is offered as either a radical initiator or a peracid oxidant, which are different kinds of reagent playing the same declared role.
discrepancies.drawing_says: n/a - no drawing anywhere on this page. The whole page is prose; an ink-band scan of the rendered image finds exactly 40 marked bands: the header line, the rule beneath it, 37 body text lines and the footer page number. Nothing else is on the page.
discrepancies.text_says: Claim 3 reads '所述催化剂为偶氮二异丁腈或间氯过氧苯甲酸' = said catalyst is AIBN or mCPBA. AIBN is a radical initiator, appropriate to the benzylic bromination of claim 1 step 1); mCPBA is a peracid oxidant. Both are printed as alternatives for the same slot. Recorded as printed and NOT resolved; a downstream chemistry pass should treat the step-1 catalyst identity as flagged rather than settled.

discrepancies.what: Omission in the prose: claim 1 step 1) never names a brominating species, yet its product is the bromomethyl compound.
discrepancies.drawing_says: n/a - no drawing on this page, so there is no scheme to supply the missing reagent.
discrepancies.text_says: Claim 1 step 1) charges only '溶剂、催化剂、氢溴酸' and then adds '双氧水' dropwise, and claim 2 gives a molar ratio for exactly those four components. Neither 溴素 nor Br2 nor any other bromine reagent is written anywhere on the page. The bromine must come from the hydrobromic acid, presumably oxidised in situ by the hydrogen peroxide, but the page does not say so and this has NOT been written into the transcription.

discrepancies.what: Image versus embedded text layer: the extracted text stream emits the footer page number twice, while the page prints it once.
discrepancies.drawing_says: n/a - no drawing on this page. Layout evidence is from the rendered image: the header carries 'CN 109678767 A' at the left, '权　利　要　求　书' centred and '1/1 页' at the right, above a full-width horizontal rule; the only mark below the body is a single '2' centred at the foot of the page.
discrepancies.text_says: The text layer for this page ends with the five items '权　利　要　求　书', '1/1 页', '2', 'CN 109678767 A', '2' in that order. The publication number belongs to the header, not the footer, and the page number '2' appears twice. The same duplication appears at the end of p03's text layer, so it is a systematic artifact of the extraction rather than something printed. Per the rule that the image wins for layout, header and footer above record one publication number and one page number.

discrepancies.what: Naming form: the trifluoroethoxymethyl substituent is printed without the outer bracket that strict IUPAC nomenclature requires.
discrepancies.drawing_says: n/a - no drawing on this page. There is no structural formula anywhere in CN109678767A's claims, so every structure on this page exists only as a name.
discrepancies.text_says: The page prints '2-氯-3-(2,2,2-三氟乙氧基)甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸' at all four occurrences, i.e. 3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl, where the strict form is 3-[(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl]. This is a bracketing convention only and changes no atom or bond; the printed form is reproduced verbatim in zh and preserved in en. Flagged so that a downstream name-to-structure pass does not mis-parse the missing bracket.

discrepancies.what: Typographic inconsistency that downstream passes must not read as meaningful.
discrepancies.drawing_says: n/a - no drawing on this page.
discrepancies.text_says: Claim 7 prints '步骤2)中所述溶剂' with no comma after 中, where claims 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 8, 9 and 10 all print '中，'. Reproduced as printed. Otherwise the page is punctuation-consistent: prose commas are full-width U+FF0C, enumeration marks U+3001, semicolons U+FF1B, the single colon U+FF1A, full stops U+3002, ranges U+FF5E, temperature U+2103; while claim numbers, step numbers, locant commas, ratio colons, decimal points and all hyphens are half-width ASCII. No space character occurs anywhere in the 37 body lines.
